import os, subprocess, threading, time, pathlib, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'bench-results/efficiency-measurement-gate-20260906')

cli='/tmp/work-leaf-cli-01534.r6qIK3/cache/_npx/61b275e57bf5ae43/node_modules/@openai/codex-linux-x64/vendor/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/bin/codex'

command=[cli,'--cd',cwd,'--sandbox','read-only','--ask-for-approval','never','-c','forced_login_method="chatgpt"','-c','model_provider="openai"','-c','model="gpt-5.5"','-c','model_reasoning_effort="xhigh"','exec','--json','-']

checks.name: inotify
checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess, threading, time, pathlib, json, sys, ctypes, struct, select
sys.path.insert(0,'bench-results/efficiency-measurement-gate-20260906')
import handoff_probe as h
cli='/tmp/work-leaf-cli-01534.r6qIK3/cache/_npx/61b275e57bf5ae43/node_modules/@openai/codex-linux-x64/vendor/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/bin/codex'
cwd='/tmp/wl-author-feedback-20260914.alMTHU/R13'
command=[cli,'--cd',cwd,'--sandbox','read-only','--ask-for-approval','never','-c','forced_login_method="chatgpt"','-c','model_provider="openai"','-c','model="gpt-5.5"','-c','model_reasoning_effort="xhigh"','exec','--json','-']
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
fd=lib.inotify_init1(os.O_NONBLOCK|os.O_CLOEXEC)
assert fd>=0
watched={}
root=pathlib.Path('/home/user/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-curated-remote')
for name,version,skill in [('deep-research-work','0.1.15','deep-research'),('plugin-management','0.1.0','plugin-management')]:
 for relative in ['.codex-plugin/plugin.json',f'skills/{skill}/SKILL.md']:
  file=root/name/version/relative
  if file.is_file():
   wd=lib.inotify_add_watch(fd,str(file).encode(),0x00000001|0x00000020)
   assert wd>=0
   watched[wd]=str(file)
p=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=cwd,env=h.child_environment(os.environ),stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
stdout=[];stderr=[]
for stream,destination in ((p.stdout,stdout),(p.stderr,stderr)):
 threading.Thread(target=lambda s=stream,d=destination:d.extend(s),daemon=True).start()
try:
 time.sleep(2)
 accesses=[]
 while select.select([fd],[],[],0)[0]:
  data=os.read(fd,65536)
  offset=0
  while offset<len(data):
   wd,mask,cookie,size=struct.unpack_from('iIII',data,offset);offset+=16+size
   accesses.append({'path':watched.get(wd),'mask':mask})
 print(json.dumps({'plugin_file_accesses_before_prompt':accesses,'watched_count':len(watched)}),flush=True)
 fds=[]
 for f in pathlib.Path(f'/proc/{p.pid}/fd').iterdir():
  try: target=os.readlink(f)
  except FileNotFoundError: continue
  if target.startswith('/home/user/.codex/'): fds.append(target)
 print(json.dumps({'command':command,'held_empty_stdin_seconds':2,'poll_before_stop':p.poll(),'codex_state_fds':fds,'stdout_before_stop':stdout,'stderr_before_stop':stderr,'model_prompt_bytes_sent':0}),flush=True)
finally:
 os.close(fd)
 p.terminate()
 try:p.wait(timeout=3)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.kill();p.wait()
 print(json.dumps({'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':stdout,'stderr':stderr,'model_prompt_bytes_sent':0}),flush=True)
PY
